results.content:
Document: shipping-handbook.en.md. Chunk 1 of 6. Content: ## Carrier cut-off times

Lumen Valley Instruments ships from one warehouse. Orders paid before 14:00 on a business day leave the warehouse the same day with the standard carrier. Orders paid after 14:00 leave on the next business day. The express carrier has an earlier cut-off of 12:00 for same-day dispatch. Orders placed on a Saturday or Sunday leave on Monday.

Document: warehouse-floorplan.png. Chunk 4 of 4. Content: ## Packing and dispatch zone

The image places the packing and dispatch zone in green on the east side, beside dock door 3. Six packing tables stand in two rows. The express carrier collection point is the red rectangle by the door, and the standard carrier pallets are stacked on the grey area behind it.

Document: shipping-handbook.en.md. Chunk 4 of 6. Content: ## Shipping costs

Standard shipping is free for orders above 250 dollars. Below that amount a flat fee of 12 dollars applies. Express shipping always costs 35 dollars. Pallet shipments are quoted by the logistics team before payment, and the quote stays valid for 7 days.

Document: shipping-handbook.en.md. Chunk 3 of 6. Content: ## Delivery times by region

Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days within the home country, 5 to 8 business days within the neighbouring region and 8 to 14 business days for all other destinations. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days at home and 3 to 4 business days in the neighbouring region. Delivery times count from dispatch, not from the order date.

Document: shipping-handbook.en.md. Chunk 6 of 6. Content: ## Damaged or lost parcels

Report a damaged parcel within 5 days of delivery and keep the outer box and the foam for inspection. Write to logistics@example.com with the order number and two photos. A parcel that has not arrived 15 business days after dispatch is treated as lost, and the logistics team either sends a replacement or hands the case to the billing team for a refund.

results.content:
Document: employee-handbook.zh.md. Chunk 1 of 6. Content: ## 年假天数

绿谷仪器的正式员工按累计工作年限享受带薪年假：累计工作满 1 年不满 10 年的，每年 5 天；满 10 年不满 20 年的，每年 10 天；满 20 年及以上的，每年 15 天。当年入职的员工，年假天数按当年剩余的日历天数折算，不足一天的部分舍去。

Document: employee-handbook.zh.md. Chunk 2 of 6. Content: ## 年假申请流程

休年假需要至少提前 3 个工作日在人事系统里提交申请，由直属主管审批。连续休假超过 5 个工作日的，还需要部门负责人再批一次。未休完的年假可以顺延到次年 3 月 31 日，过期作废，公司不以现金折算。

Document: refund-policy.zh.md. Chunk 4 of 5. Content: ## 旧版政策（2022 至 2023 年）

2023 年底之前，绿谷仪器执行的是更早的一套退货规定：无论客户选择哪种计费周期，只要在付款后 20 天以内提出，就可以办理退款，但款项一律以账户余额的形式返还，而不是退回原支付渠道。这套规定已于 2024 年 1 月 1 日废止，新订单不再适用。

Document: employee-handbook.zh.md. Chunk 3 of 6. Content: ## 病假与医疗期

员工因病需要休息时，请当天上午 10 点前通知直属主管，并在返岗后 2 日内补交医院开具的诊断证明。病假期间的工资按基本工资的 80% 发放。连续病假超过 30 天的，由人事部门另行安排医疗期的相关事宜。

Document: refund-policy.zh.md. Chunk 1 of 5. Content: ## 年度方案

绿谷仪器接受按年付费的方案申请退款。申请人需向财务部提交订单号。退款会在 15 个工作日内原路退回到付款时使用的支付方式。年度方案的退款期限为自购买之日起 60 天。

results.content:
Document: warehouse-floorplan.png. Chunk 3 of 4. Content: ## Picking aisles

The image shows Aisle A holding thermal probes and spare cables, Aisle B holding reference thermometers and data loggers, and Aisle C holding packaging material and batteries. Each aisle has shelves on both sides with four levels, and the lithium batteries sit in a fenced cage at the north end of Aisle C.

Document: product-specs.en.md. Chunk 2 of 6. Content: ## XR-4420 thermal probe

The XR-4420 thermal probe (SKU LV-77-0193) is a handheld probe for lab benches. Measurement range is -40 to 400 degrees Celsius. Accuracy is plus or minus 0.5 degrees Celsius. Response time is 2 seconds. The probe cable is 3 metres long. Power comes from two AA batteries. The housing is rated IP54. The firmware build shipped with this model is FW-2.8.14.

Document: product-specs.en.md. Chunk 1 of 6. Content: ## XR-4410 thermal probe

The XR-4410 thermal probe (SKU LV-77-0192) is a handheld probe for lab benches. Measurement range is -40 to 250 degrees Celsius. Accuracy is plus or minus 0.5 degrees Celsius. Response time is 2 seconds. The probe cable is 3 metres long. Power comes from two AA batteries. The housing is rated IP54. The firmware build shipped with this model is FW-2.8.14.

Document: shipping-handbook.en.md. Chunk 2 of 6. Content: ## Packaging rules

Every instrument is packed in a foam-lined box with a moisture sachet. Thermal probes with a cable longer than 3 metres are coiled and fixed with a paper band before boxing. Packages that weigh more than 20 kilograms are shipped on a pallet and are never sent as ordinary parcels. Batteries are packed separately from instruments and carry a lithium handling label when the model uses lithium cells.

Document: warehouse-floorplan.png. Chunk 1 of 4. Content: ## Overall layout

The image shows a floor plan of the Lumen Valley Instruments warehouse, drawn from above. The building is a long rectangle with the loading docks along the south wall and the main office in the north-east corner. Three aisles run from the south wall to the north wall, labelled Aisle A, Aisle B and Aisle C from west to east.
